cases.sentence: Если купишь ___-еврея, он прослужит у тебя шесть лет.
cases.translation: If you buy a Hebrew slave, he will serve you six years.
cases.explain: The transitive verb купить takes a direct object; for an animate noun the accusative equals the genitive form раба.

cases.translation: Let the master bring him to the judges.
cases.explain: The preposition к governs the dative case (here plural судьям).

cases.sentence: На седьмой год он должен стать свободным без ___.
cases.translation: In the seventh year he must become free without a ransom.
cases.explain: The preposition без governs the genitive case.

cases.sentence: Пусть господин подведет его к дверному ___.
cases.translation: Let the master bring him to the doorpost.
cases.explain: The preposition к governs the dative case.

cases.translation: The master will pierce his ear with an awl.
cases.explain: The instrumental case expresses the means or instrument of an action.

cases.sentence: Она не должна освобождаться из ___, как рабы мужчины.
cases.translation: She must not be freed from slavery like the male slaves.
cases.explain: The preposition из governs the genitive case.

cases.translation: One strikes the other with a stone or with a fist.
cases.explain: The instrumental case expresses the means or instrument of an action.

cases.sentence: Но хозяин ___ не будет в ответе.
cases.translation: But the owner of the bull will not be held responsible.
cases.explain: The noun хозяин (owner) governs a following genitive of possession.

reading.ru: Если купишь раба-еврея, и он прослужит у тебя шесть лет, то на седьмой год он должен стать свободным без выкупа.
reading.question: When does a Hebrew servant go free?
options: In the seventh year, without payment
Only if he buys his freedom
reading.correct: In the seventh year, without payment
reading.explain: The text says after six years 'на седьмой год он должен стать свободным без выкупа' (in the seventh year he must become free without ransom).

reading.ru: Любой, кто ударит человека и убьет его, будет предан смерти.
reading.question: What is the penalty for striking and killing a man?
options: He shall be put to death
reading.correct: He shall be put to death
reading.explain: The text says such a person 'будет предан смерти' (shall be put to death).

reading.ru: Любой, кто ударит отца или мать, должен быть предан смерти.
reading.question: What happens to anyone who strikes his father or mother?
options: He must be put to death
reading.correct: He must be put to death
reading.explain: The text says he 'должен быть предан смерти' (must be put to death).

reading.ru: Если хозяин ударит раба или рабыню палкой, и раб тотчас умрет, то хозяин должен быть наказан.
reading.question: What if a master strikes his servant with a rod and the servant dies at once?
options: The master must free all his servants
The master must pay the family
reading.explain: The text says in that case 'хозяин должен быть наказан' (the master must be punished).

reading.ru: Если будет причинен вред, то берите жизнь за жизнь, глаз за глаз, зуб за зуб, ногу за ногу, ожог за ожог, рану за рану, ушиб за ушиб.
reading.question: What principle applies if serious harm is done?
options: Life for life, eye for eye, tooth for tooth
A fine paid to the judges
reading.correct: Life for life, eye for eye, tooth for tooth
reading.explain: The text lists 'жизнь за жизнь, глаз за глаз, зуб за зуб' (life for life, eye for eye, tooth for tooth).

reading.ru: Если бык забодает мужчину или женщину до смерти, то быка нужно забить камнями, а мясо его есть нельзя.
reading.question: What happens to a bull that gores a person to death?
options: It must be stoned and its meat not eaten
It is given to the victim's family
reading.correct: It must be stoned and its meat not eaten
reading.explain: The text says 'быка нужно забить камнями, а мясо его есть нельзя' (the bull must be stoned and its meat must not be eaten).
